Adding a skip path where the edge was absent gives a larger gain than swapping one existing op for a skip.
A strong direct 0->3 conv already supplies capacity, so the extra gain from a conv on edge 5 is smaller.
Replacing a missing edge into the output with a conv adds a path, a larger gain than upgrading an existing op.
With edge 1 absent, edge 0 is the only way into node 1, so removing it cuts connectivity and hurts more.
With edge 5 absent, the paths through node 2 into the output are weaker, so removing edge 0 loses more.

raw:
These ten hypotheses come from the 100 experiments, and I kept only those that also make architectural sense. I did not run any new experiments.

- **Edit edge 3 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 3 is none:** this adds a direct input-to-output path where there was none, so it should help more than upgrading an existing operation. Experiments 71-80 agree, e.g. +3.82/+6.50/+17.47 against +0.96/-0.02/+3.67 for a skip parent.
- **Edit edge 3 to skip_connect when edge 3 is none:** this has the same logic. Experiments 21-29 show clear gains across all three datasets, with one outlier (#30, an all-skip parent) that goes strongly negative.
- **Edit edge 5 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 3 is nor_conv_3x3:** the direct 0->3 path is already strong, so the marginal gain is smaller. Experiment 16 shows +0.16/-1.50/+1.07 against a larger gain in the other edge-5 experiments.
- **Edit edge 5 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 5 is none:** this restores a path into the output node. Experiment 11 gives +4.64/+10.26/+16.70, larger than the skip, pool and conv1x1 replacements.
- **Edit edge 0 to none when edge 1 is none:** this cuts the only route into node 1 and its outgoing edges. Experiment 65 shows -6.81/-13.56/-17.07.
- **Edit edge 0 to none when edge 5 is none:** this removes input paths while edge 5 is also absent. Experiment 69 shows -5.95/-13.22/-14.20.
- **Edit edge 0 to none when edge 3 is none:** removing edge 0 leaves less redundancy for carrying the input forward. Experiment 67 shows -3.39/-5.08/-6.80, worse than the skip-edge-3 parent.
- **Edit edge 0 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 3 is none:** the gain is smaller or negative. Experiment 8 shows -0.52/-1.78/-3.80, against positive gains elsewhere. This is the least certain of the ten on mechanism; I kept it because the data are consistent.
- **Edit edge 0 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 0 is nor_conv_1x1:** upgrading 1x1 to 3x3 gains less than replacing skip, pool or none. Experiment 3 gives +1.39/+0.56/+1.87.
- **Edit edge 4 to nor_conv_3x3 when edge 0 is none:** edge 4 depends on node 1, which receives input only via edge 0. Experiment 55 gives +0.14/+0.36/+1.07, against roughly +2 to +3 / +4 to +5 / +6 to +9 elsewhere.
